definition: Ryen W. White (born 1979) is a Scottish-American computer scientist and technical leader at Microsoft in Redmond, WA, USA..
details: He is a Distinguished Scientist and a Vice President of Applied Science, currently leading the science organization for OneDrive and SharePoint. Ryen is known for his contributions to information retrieval, human-computer interaction, and computational health.

explainer.lead: Ryen W. White is a Scottish-American computer scientist (born 1979).

contributions.name: White co-founded and chaired the inaugural steering committee for the ACM Conference on Computer Human Interaction and Retrieval (CHIIR).

He founded the SIGIR Academy to recognize those making significant, cumulative contributions to the field of Information Retrieval, and SIGIR Futures, to support high-ambition, future-oriented research in information retrieval.

timeline.what: His doctoral dissertation received the British Computer Society Distinguished Dissertation Award in 2005.
White has served as program chair for The ACM Web Conference in 2019 and the ACM SIGIR Conference in 2017.
